title: Image manifest
description: Variables for an image in images/src/<image>/manifest.json, used to render template.json and tag the built image.

name.description: Display name of the image, and its org.opencontainers.image.title label.

description.description: Short description of the image, and its org.opencontainers.image.description label.

version.description: Image version as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, without a v. A release labels the image with org.opencontainers.image.version v<version>, and a dev build with v<version>-dev.

tags.description: Base tags. A release build tags each on its own and with -vMAJOR, -vMAJOR.MINOR and -vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH suffixes. A dev build tags the same, with -dev added to the end of each, such as base-v1.2.3-dev.

build_args.description: Build arguments passed to the Containerfile, rendered into build.args in .devcontainer.json.
